freeze_rule: Committed before any four-layer stochastic output was generated.
composition: At each denoising step, project the union of semantic masks whose half-open window [tweak_index, endpoint) is active.

rationale.rigid: Retain utensil category and geometry until late denoising.
rationale.contact: Retain support/grip topology through the middle-late phase.
rationale.material: Release deformable food early enough to recover photorealistic texture.
rationale.hole: Inject the repaired source proxy early, then release it to avoid a blurred or proxy-like patch.

selection_policy: One diagnostic schedule for all four families. No per-case or output-dependent adjustment before the first four-anchor review.
